# openstatus_monitor (Data Source)

Fetches an existing OpenStatus monitor by ID. Returns monitor details including type-specific fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openstatus_monitor" "existing" {
  id = "123"
}

output "monitor_name" {
  value = data.openstatus_monitor.existing.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the monitor.

### Read-Only

- `type` (String) Monitor type (`http`, `tcp`, or `dns`).
- `name` (String) Display name of the monitor.
- `url` (String) URL being monitored (HTTP monitors only).
- `uri` (String) URI being monitored (TCP and DNS monitors only).
- `periodicity` (String) Check frequency.
- `method` (String) HTTP method (HTTP monitors only).
- `active` (Boolean) Whether monitoring is active.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is publicly visible.
- `description` (String) Description of the monitor.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in milliseconds.
- `status` (String) Current status of the monitor.
